messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert: Hosted API p95=2.4s, p99=7.2s in us-west-2. Request queue depth increasing from 3k -> 18k in 12m. Autoscaler health = degraded.
maya (oncall): Seeing a ton of 429s reported by customers? Any evidence of throttling upstream or GPU pool saturation?
ryan: GPU pools in us-west-2 reporting 100% allocation. Provisioner logs show create_instance errors: quota_exceeded and rate_limited.
sophia: Logs snippet from provisioner: ```ERROR provisioner: createInstance failed: quota_exceeded: 'GPUS in region'
ERROR autoscaler: leader heartbeat lag 4500ms, reconcile loop skipped```
james: Paging cloudops for quota/limits. If quota can't increase, we need fallback routing to eu or smaller model variants.
cloudops: On it. Opening support ticket with cloud provider (INC-23711). ETA for quota bump unknown (est 30-90m). We can allocate some preemptible nodes manually if you want a quick patch.
maya (oncall): Do that. Also can we toggle degraded-mode in the hosted API to reject long-running requests and prioritize small tokens? We need to reduce queue pressure.
sophia: Yes — there's an emergency config 'hosted.degraded_mode=partial_reject' that will 503 requests > max_tokens=2048 and route rest. Rolling it to 100% will be ~15s to propagate. Recommend canary first.
ryan: While rolling, I'm going to restart the autoscaler leader (raft leader). There's evidence of leader meta not committing scale requests. Command: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-leader && kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler -f --since=5m```
liz: Heads-up: restarting leader will cause brief reconciliation pause (~20s) but might unstick createInstance retries. Approved.
maya (oncall): Do it. Execute now and update when done.
deploy-bot: Started rollout for deployment/autoscaler-leader by ryan at 1769998923.
ryan: Leader restart done. Observed backlog of pending scale ops cleared from queue: 980 -> 120. Provisioner errors still present but leader now resubmitting creates.
james: Immediate mitigation: enable degraded_mode canary on 10% of traffic in us-west-2. Command: ```redwoodctl config set hosted.degraded_mode=partial_reject --region=us-west-2 --percent=10```
sophia: Canary enabled. p95 dropped to 1.1s in canary slice, p99 unchanged across region. Queue growth rate slowed in slice.
cloudops: Provider increased API rate limits for account temporarily, but GPU soft quota still at limit. They advised to request quota increase for n1-standard-gpu fleet, ticket INC-23711 has priority.
maya (oncall): Next steps: 1) expand degraded_mode to 60% if queue not improving in 10m. 2) Start manual preemptible pool allocation: ryan/cloudops pair. 3) Notify support/sales about impacted customers with possible timeouts.
ryan: Allocated 40 preemptible GPUs in us-west-2, attached to dedicated fallback pool. Provisioner accepted them; autoscaler acknowledged new capacity. Queue depth started to fall 18k -> 6.2k over 8m.
liz: I'm drafting customer-facing note for affected tenants: short explanation, interim mitigations, classifier for impacted request types. Will share for review.
james: We should also enable model-fallback to medium-large model (quantized) for best-effort routing. Config snippet: ```routing.rules.us-west-2: - condition: queue_depth>5000 action: route_to: quantized-medium model_variant```
sophia: Enabled routing rule. p95 overall now 0.9s, p99 2.8s and decreasing. No new 500s observed; 429s down but still present for longest requests.
maya (oncall): Good work. Handing over on-call to ryan for next 2h while I join the customer call. ryan you're primary, message me on urgent P0.
ryan: Taking lead. Will monitor autoscaler logs, cloud quota, and queue. If queue re-spikes above 7k, escalate to SEV1 and open broad-notice.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=SEV2, impact=multiple tenants; mitigation=degraded_mode_canary, manual_preemptible_pool, model-fallback routing, autoscaler leader restart.
liz: Customer note ready. Sending to growth/support now.\n--- Post-incident notes (added by maya) ---
maya (oncall): Postmortem action items: 1) autoscaler leader monitoring: add alert for raft commit lag > 2s. 2) Provisioner quota-exceed path: implement graceful degrade that auto-routes to other regions before queue growth. 3) Run a drill to validate preemptible pool attach path under 1m. 4) Improve SLOs doc for degraded_mode gating and rollback playbook.
ryan: I'll file infra tickets: INFRA-492 (raft monitoring), INFRA-493 (preemptible attach automation).
james: Work with product to define routing rules for queue-based model fallback (PROD-78).
maya (oncall): Closing thread for now. If anything re-opens, ping @maya and @ryan. :white_check_mark:
